answer: Each new identity must lock a refundable 340 POA bond for 85 days behind one device key, and the bond returns only after that key passes 12 sequential live checks, so a farm cannot share one bond or run timber copies in parallel. Randomly assigned willow auditors compare each check against the agent's public work log and flag any key used under two names. A flagged key loses the whole bond and its garden registry entry is struck, barring that key from opening another identity.
